experiences.description:
- Owner/operator of Striped Seed Co., a Canadian DTC ecommerce brand adapting professional turf industry products to the homeowner and lawncare enthusiasts market.
- Executing all aspects of the business including product development, go-to-market strategy, growth marketing, back-office operations, and customer support
- 4.9 out of 5 star rating with over 8,000 customers across Canada
Developed and led go-to-market strategy for Shop Promise, Shopify’s delivery badge solution that helps merchants showcase reliable, fast delivery experiences to their customers.

Managed a team of 30+ content professionals, producers, and localization experts accountable for the planning and execution of Shopify's core content strategy and multilingual content marketing program, spanning editorial, YouTube, podcasting, and online courses.

The team developed and maintained a content program that reached an audience of over 5M entrepreneurs each month with content that was localized into 10+ languages. The team was also accountable for developing targeted and relevant content-based funnels that accelerated the journey from visitor to customer. 

Working with a combination of in-house, best-in-class content creators as well as through the use of external contractors and agencies, the Content Marketing team delivered a multi-channel,  performance-based content program that championed the opportunity of entrepreneurship and provided a clear path to starting and growing a business that lasts.

- Founder and creator of Toronto Food Trucks, a hyper-local food truck tracker website and media company which grew to 100,000 monthly readers and 10k+ email subscribers in 1.5 years.
- Acquired in 2013 by Fresh Daily Inc. (BlogTO)
- http://torontofoodtrucks.ca/
